overview: Foreign policy, international relations, international institutions and fora, and Central/AP government schemes: 30 official questions (2008-2024). Central schemes (13) and international bodies (8) dominate; the AP-scheme leaf has 4. Questions are current-affairs driven: one-liners on a scheme's objective or a body's committee, and since 2023 statement-based items on scheme design (target group, funding, coverage) and foreign-policy terms.

possibility.angle: India's foreign policy doctrines and summits
possibility.what_they_ask: NAM summit venue; Look/Act East, Connect Central Asia, Think West, MAITRI meanings
cross-border trains; port-funder pairs (Hambantota, Gwadar, Chabahar); exercise founding members (DOSTI)
membership of G4/G7; UN committee numbers (1267); conference frequency; first woman heads; G20 themes and hosts; convention-sector pairs; BIMSTEC MoUs
scheme objective (Indradhanush, BBBP, RMK); target year (malaria 2030); target group (PM-AJAY = SC); funding ratio; coverage of NIP; NMP design; PM-MKSSY outlay
objective of an AP scheme (Badikosta, Neeru-Chettu); which scheme is outside Navaratnalu; AP app for women (Disha)

traps.trap: [Instrument vs objective] The scheme's tool offered as its goal
traps.spot: Options describe the bicycle, plantation or loan instead of the aim
traps.fix: Badikosta's bicycles serve to cut girls' dropout; Neeru-Chettu is water conservation first (desilting)
traps.pyq: Badikosta → minimise dropout of girls [group1-prelims-2017-paper1#64]; Neeru-Chettu → desiltation of tanks [group1-prelims-2017-paper1#67]

traps.spot: Hindi scheme names with Anusuchit Jaati / Janjati
traps.fix: Anusuchit Jaati = Scheduled Castes (PM-AJAY); Janjati = Tribes
NIP covers economic and social, greenfield and brownfield projects

traps.spot: G20 theme statements for Indonesia and India
traps.fix: Indonesia 2022 'Recover Together, Recover Stronger'; India 2023 'One Earth, One Family, One Future'

traps.trap: Funder or country of a strategic port swapped
traps.fix: Hambantota = China in Sri Lanka; Gwadar = Pakistan; Chabahar = Iran with India

traps.trap: Founding pair of a trilateral exercise swapped
traps.spot: 'DOSTI started in 1991 between India and Sri Lanka'
traps.fix: DOSTI began 1991 India-Maldives; Sri Lanka joined 2012

traps.trap: A member of the bloc already in the P5
traps.spot: 'Not part of G4' with China among G4 nations
traps.fix: G4 = Brazil, Germany, India, Japan; China is P5

techniques.name: Scheme five-point card
techniques.how: [Ministry, year, target, aim, funding] For every scheme in the news, note these five; statement items alter one of them.
techniques.example: PM-SYM 50:50 worker-Centre, PM-AJAY for SCs, Karmayogi six pillars → all statements incorrect [group1-prelims-2024-paper1#43]

techniques.name: Name decoding
techniques.how: Decode the scheme or programme name; the words usually state the aim.
techniques.example: Indradhanush (seven colours = seven vaccines) → immunisation [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#77]; Beti Bachao = child sex ratio, not legal aid [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#67]

techniques.name: City-named convention table
techniques.how: Map each city treaty to its sector: Chicago aviation, Montreal ozone, Kyoto GHG, Basel hazardous waste, Rotterdam chemicals.

techniques.name: Programme-in-basket check
techniques.how: For 'not part of X' (Navaratnalu), list the basket's items; the scheme outside is the answer even if it is real.
techniques.example: Navaratnalu includes housing, Jalayagnam, Aarogyasri; Vahana Mitra is separate [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#86]

techniques.name: Number-labelled UN committees
techniques.how: Remember the resolution numbers: 1267 Al-Qaida/ISIL sanctions, 1373 counter-terrorism, 1540 WMD.
techniques.example: Masood Azhar listed by the 1267 Committee (May 2019) [group1-prelims-2019-paper2#103]

confusions.remember: economic start vs strategic, political, cultural expansion
Gulf/West Asia vs Central Asian states (summit 2022)
Sri Lanka, China-funded vs Iran with India / Pakistan with China
UNSC aspirants (Brazil, Germany, India, Japan) vs USA, UK, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Canada
individual terrorist listing vs counter-terrorism monitoring
new investment pipeline vs leasing brownfield public assets
AP SOS for women vs Telangana support centres
credit fund for poor women vs SHG empowerment scheme
coast guards India-Maldives-Sri Lanka vs navies of the Quad

anchors: UNSC 1267 Committee listed Masood Azhar, 1 May 2019
G20: Bali 2022 'Recover Together, Recover Stronger'; India 2023 'One Earth, One Family, One Future'
BBBP 2015: child sex ratio, survival and education of girls
NIP Dec 2019: economic + social, greenfield + brownfield; NMP Aug 2021: brownfield, ownership retained
AP: Badikosta 2017 (girls' dropout), Neeru-Chettu 2015 (tanks), Disha app 2020
checklist: Separate the scheme's aim from its instrument.
Check target group words (Jaati vs Janjati, women vs girls, BPL).
'Only' / 'alone' in coverage statements: verify the full scope.
For summits and themes, fix host and year together.
Is the item really inside the named basket (Navaratnalu, G4)?
Note when the key was unofficial or time-bound and do not over-learn it.
